name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI Marketing Operations & Automation Architect
summary: Agentic operator and marketing systems architect who builds and owns production AI agents and automations that execute full-funnel marketing — without engineering support. 15+ years across MarTech, SaaS, and agency environments, including 5+ years hands-on building CRM and marketing-automation infrastructure. I wire LLM workflows into the marketing stack, absorb messy stakeholder requirements and turn them into clean, scoped builds, and treat every system like a product: monitoring, iteration loops, and evaluation frameworks included.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for B2B service businesses — automating lead enrichment, scoring, outreach, and appointment booking as production systems that run 24/7 without engineering support.

Break down high-volume manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic — including an automated audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to generate hyper-personalized outreach.

Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs, catch failures, and continuously optimize conversion — treating internal tooling like a product with fallback logic and iteration cycles.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions — the bridge between messy business intent and reliable LLM output.

Rebuilt clients' marketing operations infrastructure end-to-end: 20+ deployed workflows spanning lead capture and routing, qualification and scoring, lifecycle management, nurture, reactivation, and review generation.
Wire automation and enrichment tooling into client CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel) and CMS platforms so the right data reaches the right system at the right time, with strict data-hygiene protocols.
